# PANACEA Hash Garden

> Premium 21+ smoke shop and botanical apothecary in Corpus Christi, Texas. PANACEA grows its own flower and makes its own concentrates and edibles — plus artisan glass, THC beverages, accessories, and branded merch. It's also a community venue hosting comedy, live music, and local art & vendor markets.

- Address: 4914 Everhart Rd, Corpus Christi, TX 78411
- Phone: (361) 752-4168
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10 AM–10 PM, closed Sunday
- Age policy: 21+ only
- Founder: Rene Pena
- Sales model: botanicals in-store only (no online checkout); branded merch ships nationwide via https://panaceahg.printful.me/

## Pages

- [Home](https://panaceastx.com/): Overview of the shop, categories, events, merch, and location
- [Products](https://panaceastx.com/products): In-store catalog — house-grown flower, in-house concentrates, glass, THC drinks, homemade edibles, accessories
- [Events](https://panaceastx.com/events): Backyard comedy nights, live music, art & vendor markets, events calendar, and performer/vendor booking
- [Merch](https://panaceastx.com/merch): PANACEA-branded apparel (hoodies, caps, jackets, tees, backpacks) shipped via the online store, plus original paintings from local Corpus Christi artists in-store
- [About](https://panaceastx.com/about): Founder Rene Pena's story, the "grown, made, crafted" philosophy, and the approach to cannabis genetics and cultivation
- [Contact](https://panaceastx.com/contact): Location map, hours, phone, and message form
- [The Journal](https://panaceastx.com/blog): Guides written by the shop

## Journal articles

- [What Is a Botanical Apothecary?](https://panaceastx.com/blog/what-is-a-botanical-apothecary/): Defines the botanical apothecary format and how it differs from a conventional smoke shop
- [Visiting a 21+ Smoke Shop in Corpus Christi](https://panaceastx.com/blog/visiting-a-21-plus-smoke-shop-corpus-christi/): ID requirements, hours, in-store categories, and what can and cannot be ordered online
- [How to Choose Artisan Glass](https://panaceastx.com/blog/how-to-choose-artisan-glass/): Borosilicate vs soft glass, joint sizes and fit, wall thickness, hand-worked detail, cleaning and storage

## Notes

- PANACEA sells federally legal hemp-derived products to adults 21 and over in compliance with applicable Texas law; product selection changes as Texas hemp regulations evolve.
- The shop grows its own flower and produces its own concentrates and edibles for transparency and quality control.
